limitations: No target dataset backfill or target intranet write was performed; the zero remaining/gap result belongs only to local synthetic fixtures.
The required continuous 24-hour observation and at least 100 Current Analysis promotions were not performed, so the full G6 rollout gate is not closed.
The repository default remains legacy; strict-writer and projection-read were exercised by tests but were not enabled on a deployed service.
The PostgreSQL EXPLAIN deliberately disabled sequential scans to prove index eligibility; it is not a target-volume planner-cost benchmark.
No real RustFS, Core, Symbolicator, full Compose traffic, remote CI, browser UAT, target deployment, or two-release rollback observation was exercised.
Database downgrade after split double-null identities is intentionally unsupported; rollback uses compatible code and the legacy feature mode.
